tools.name: search_address
tools.description: Search Danish addresses by free text (street, number, floor/door, postcode). Returns address ids to pass to get_valuation. Example query: "Kilevej 6, 1. mf, 2000".

tools.name: get_valuation
tools.description: Statistical market-value estimate for one Danish home: value, likely range, confidence, how it was calculated, the comparable sales it rests on, earlier registered sales and the yearly property tax a new owner would pay. Takes an address_id from search_address. A cold lookup can take up to a minute.

tools.name: get_postcode_sales
tools.description: Registered home sales in a Danish postcode over the past year, per property type: count, median price, median price per m² and the most recent sales with links to their own valuations.
